accepted_math: Common positive metric and explicit physical embedding are required; matching coefficient shapes are insufficient.
After explicit Gram normalization, M=Uhat^dagger W Vhat=A Sigma B^dagger and Q=B A^dagger yield U(k)-covariant alignment.
Equal-rank projector operator distance is the largest singular value of W^(1/2)(Vhat-Uhat M); atan2 of residual/overlap singular values preserves tiny-angle information within roundoff limits.
Transported columns need a rotated small operator; supplied V^dagger W H V is transformed by the complete nonunitary normalization and unitary polar map.
Without the projected H form, Q^dagger diag(E) Q is explicitly nominal on the normalized frame and is not a recomputed physical H projection.
Internal degeneracy is compatible with isolated cluster transport; omitted exact partners close a full-energy boundary.
Positive sampled guard spacing does not enclose unprovided spectrum, continuum, or L_y matrix-element error.
